methodology: Only files present in the original Git tree count as modified originals. New tracked files are separate. Current tracked working-tree edits are included; untracked additions are not included in the totals until staged. Git line counts are quantitative, not proof that a retained change is minimal.

ledger.decision: Restored upstream recursive pnpm build and install cache mount. Retained only extension workspace manifest, runtime WASM and downstream nginx fragment copies; the actual recursive build passed.

sid binds revocation; roster/source/phone fields are signed join identity claims consumed by both clients and authentication. They are type-only metadata, not feature logic.
